method: One public bundle per fresh Chromium process, fixed shared URL and fixture module; four balanced AB/BA process pairs; five warmup and nine measured batches. Identical fixed repetitions from the Node/Bun fixture catalogue. Full per-row native includes oracle before timing; index-weighted checksums after each timed batch. Timed region compiles one predicate and scans all rows per repetition.

correctness.checks: Native substring oracle; writer, shared/copy attachments, existing predicates after growth, invalid indexes
